name: Futures and Commodities Profit Calculator
meta_title: Futures Profit Calculator: Ticks, P&L and Margin
meta_description: Calculate futures and commodity profit or loss from tick size, tick value, entry and exit prices and contracts, with notional value and margin as a % of it.
subtitle: Work out the profit or loss on a futures or commodity trade from the contract specifications, your entry and exit prices and the number of contracts, with margin shown as a share of notional value.
